answer: To join the grading set, an applicant must recruit two established miners who each lock 1% of spendable balance as a surety that can bridge their own stake to the new key. Those sponsors must occupy a separate reputation knoll: invite-graph distance of at least three, and Jaccard overlap of last-epoch counterparties below 0.15. If the newcomer's sealed-grade sequence later becomes a near-perfect mirror of another address (cosine similarity above 0.92 across twenty epochs), the sureties of applicant and both sponsors are burned. A clone factory then bankrupts its backers, not unused keys.
